stemMd: A workshop in Turin measures six steel rods and finds that their mean length is 8 cm. A seventh rod is then measured, and the mean length of all seven rods is 9 cm. How long, in centimetres, is the seventh rod?
explanationMd:
**What to notice first.** A mean is a total divided by a count, so work with totals.

Six rods with mean 8 cm total $6\cdot8=48$ cm. Seven rods with mean 9 cm total $7\cdot9=63$ cm. The seventh rod accounts for the difference: $63-48=15$ cm.

**Check.** $\dfrac{48+15}{7}=\dfrac{63}{7}=9$. Also, the new rod is 6 cm longer than the new mean, and those 6 cm are shared as the 1 cm rise for each of the six old rods: $6\cdot1=6$.

distractorRationale.a: This assumes the new rod is as long as the new mean. The mean has risen by 1 because the seventh rod is longer than 9, enough to lift the total for all seven.
distractorRationale.b: This starts from the old mean, 8 cm, and adds the 1 cm rise for each of the six old rods, $8+6\cdot1=14$. But the seventh rod must itself reach the new mean of 9 cm before it can supply those 6 extra centimetres, so it is $9+6\cdot1=15$ cm; a rod of 14 cm would give a total of 62 cm and a mean below 9.
distractorRationale.d: This adds the old mean and the new mean, $8+9$. Means cannot be added to recover a missing value; the totals are what add up.
distractorRationale.e: This is the total length of all seven rods, $7\cdot9$. The length of the seventh rod alone is what is left after taking away the 48 cm of the first six.

accessibilityText: Six rods have a mean length of eight centimetres. After a seventh rod is added the mean of all seven is nine centimetres. Find the length of the seventh rod.

provenance.notes: Original item on the arithmetic mean. The trap answers correspond to using means instead of totals.

independentSolve.workingNotes: The six rods total 48 cm and the seven total 63 cm, so the seventh rod is 15 cm. E (63) is the new total and A (9) is the new mean. No other option is defensible. [A second, separate blind solve (blind-reviewer-wave6-tili-math-run7) reached the same answer: The total goes from 6*8 = 48 to 7*9 = 63, so the seventh rod is 15. Option E (63) is the total and A (9) is the new mean. None of the others is defensible.]
